verdict.notes: The two main flows are found, but the public-first generalization ignores canonical private aliases, and selected is populated despite the report saying otherwise. The note/injection and admission/default-registration coverage are omitted. Short positive grammar/length comments do not establish the complete validation path.
unsupported_gap_claims: Putting any public name first bypasses the check. — Batch canonicalizes before issue. A public-spelled private alias such as public/people first becomes private/payroll and is denied to a reader. Only a first canonical public target passes.

Today `selected` is never populated or checked. — issue explicitly initializes Grant.selected with names. It is not checked by dispatch, but it is populated, so the combined claimed missing population/check is materially inaccurate.
